# SEC001-R01 — Production image identity and coverage reconciliation
**Approval:** Owner approved proceeding with recommended bounded security-remediation sequence (2026-11-09). This issue authorizes **read-only inventory, analysis and an RFC/proposed diff**, not switching production images, altering the seven scan gates, removing excluded roles, publishing artifacts, bypassing checks or modifying PR #89 while another Codex run owns it.

**Baseline:** Draft PR [#89](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/pull/89) assessment commit `ecfdff2cf3f9d1a7b7b284e79a7f708d1baea8ce`; [SEC001 report](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/ecfdff2cf3f9d1a7b7b284e79a7f708d1baea8ce/docs/verification/sprint1-integration/sec001-2026-11-09/REPORT.md) and [remediation plan](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/ecfdff2cf3f9d1a7b7b284e79a7f708d1baea8ce/docs/verification/sprint1-integration/sec001-2026-11-09/REMEDIATION_PLAN.md).

## Already verified divergence on exact source
- `.github/workflows/security-artifacts.yml` scans seven roles: `backend-runtime` (runtime), `backend-migration`, `uat-backend`, `frontend` using **`frontend/Dockerfile.demo`**, `postgres`, `ingestion-gateway`, and `otel-contrib`.
- `deploy/release/image-policy.json` declares production candidate roles for backend-runtime, migration, postgres-alpine, contrib, frontend and gateway, but **excludes `frontend/Dockerfile.demo` and `backend/Dockerfile.uat`**. The runtime frontend Dockerfile is `frontend/Dockerfile.runtime` and is not in this seven-role CI matrix.
- The image-policy candidate IDs/source commits are older candidate metadata and do not equal current scan image config IDs or approved OCI manifest digests. All `approved_release_registry_digest` fields are null. Do not confuse local config SHA with registry manifest digest.
- `frontend/Dockerfile.runtime` defaults to `https://api.example.invalid`; actual customer-facing API/CSP/ingress values require independent owner confirmation. Do **not** bake real endpoints, credentials or tenant configuration into the proposal.
- Other deployment references and builder, legacy, bundle and distribution paths have NOT been exhaustively inspected here.

## Read-only deliverables
1. Produce an exact-sha matrix of **all** Docker/Compose consumers, target/stage, architecture, source digest, current immutable image config ID, proposed final release manifest identity, build toolchain, scanner evidence and actual distribution role; mark every missing field UNKNOWN.
2. Reconcile production/release vs demo/UAT scans without removing any existing seven gates. Propose precise additive final runtime coverage and policy assertions with fail-closed identity checks, license/bundle inventories and no conflicting role aliases.
3. Identify frontend compiled JS/npx bundle components missing from OS-only Syft scan, CI/build inputs and any off-matrix final images; mark unverified.
4. Identify dependency/compatibility cost of each coverage addition, exact changes proposed but **do not apply** until scoped owner review.
5. Deliver evidence, test matrix, reviewer decision register and a delta review to Issue #92/#94 without claiming security completion.

**Responsibility to be assigned:** product/release owner, build lead, security reviewer. No identities/signatures fabricated.

**Exit:** exact candidate-role map; proposal to preserve seven existing failures while adding genuine final-artifact scans; explicit list of missing owner environments/identities. No artifact publication or CI modification in this issue.

**Gate:** CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO. All 13 required status checks unchanged.

## Additional deployment/build/distribution consumers inspected
- [`.github/workflows/security-artifacts.yml`](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/b1e645f342be5bc84141f314a12a81d3c38f621b/.github/workflows/security-artifacts.yml): seven listed roles. This is the **enforced image scan set**, not the complete distribution set.
- [`.github/workflows/local-uat-image-validation.yml`](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/b1e645f342be5bc84141f314a12a81d3c38f621b/.github/workflows/local-uat-image-validation.yml): builds `backend/Dockerfile.uat` and `frontend/Dockerfile.demo` (the latter includes API-origin build args); candidate-only, not a production certification.

The production `image-policy.json` explicitly excludes these paths, but **a published UAT artifact still needs distribution-specific SBOM/license/scans and exact approved digest provenance**. - [`deploy/uat/compose.images.yml`](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/b1e645f342be5bc84141f314a12a81d3c38f621b/deploy/uat/compose.images.yml) and `compose.local-images.yml`: API, worker and migration reference external digest-pinned backend inputs, while frontend uses a separate digest-pinned variable. **Actual operator values are UNKNOWN**.

Restrict to localhost synthetic use.
- [`docker-compose.yml`](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/b1e645f342be5bc84141f314a12a81d3c38f621b/docker-compose.yml) uses local development `postgres:17` without immutable release qualification.

The seven Linux image scans **do not certify Windows agent packages or the delivered installers**.
- `backend/Dockerfile.demo` also embeds pinned collector 0.123.0 and is outside production image policy. `frontend/Dockerfile.runtime` builds Node 24→NGINX; actual runtime dist JS, transitive npm sources, base layers, CSP/API-origin configuration and final registry manifests are not covered by the seven-role report. The source default `https://api.example.invalid` is not a usable production API address.

## Approval-gated corrective scope proposal
1. Preserve all **seven current image-evidence roles** and their failed results; do not suppress/remove `uat-backend` or demo frontend checks.
2. Propose **additive** scan role(s) for actual `frontend/Dockerfile.runtime`, with exact stage, build args, trust/CA secret, CycloneDX, Syft+Grype, frontend JavaScript dependency attribution, NOTICE and provenance checks. Name distinct role from demo frontend. The production frontend source should use explicitly reviewed API origin/CSP/ingress values; never invent or bake customer credentials.
3. Propose fail-closed linkage between declared production roles and the real source/digest/stage/config ID + final OCI manifest digest; mark missing approved values `UNKNOWN`/blocked. Policy `contrib` evaluation-only image must not be presented as current production collector.
4. Add **separate UAT-publisher artifact identity/license/security verification** when the manually gated publisher is eventually used, plus Windows/Linux agent package evidence and builder/bundle inventories; not a request to run publication.
5. Regression criteria: matrix completeness; unchanged seven checks; missing/mismatched final image fails; CI and actual release image consistency; correct tenant/security/config safeguards; positive/negative scanner fixture tests; exact-source artifacts and reviewer signatures. Full distro/runtime fixes and independent legal review remain separate.

**Current extent/unknowns:** The above is a verified baseline mapping of the enumerated CI, production policy, UAT, demo, developer and agent paths, **not a complete registry promotion audit**. Final registry manifests, deployed production image consumers/versions, operator UAT image values, frontend final API/CSP inputs, manifest attestation and externally hosted artifacts are **not provided**; therefore final-image coverage cannot be certified.

**Status:** R01 SOURCE-INVENTORY/DELTA **COMPLETE**, FINAL-IMAGE VERIFICATION **BLOCKED**, IMPLEMENTATION NOT STARTED. Exact scanned 984 findings remain unresolved. CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO. No code/CI/image/registry/deployment modification.
